name: Cut Characterization of Ordering Width
proof: Every prefix chain first exits any admissible $R$, and the exact prefix-slope formula bounds the boundary value by the chain maximum. Conversely, for $a=\sigma(C)$ take $R$ to consist of the empty set and all subclasses reachable by adding concepts through nonempty prefixes with $\nu_k<a$. The full class is not reachable, and every outgoing boundary has value at least $a$. The face-homology formula supplies the stated certificates.
comments: The certificate can have exponential size; the theorem does not assert efficient recognition.
